SELECT
bok.BOOKSET_ID AS PROD_ID, NVL(bok.BOOKSET_NAME,bok.BOOKSET_FULLNAME) AS PROD_NAME, NVL(prodAdd.PORTFOLIO_ID,bok.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID) AS PORTFOLIO_ID,
fin.FINPROD_ID AS FINPROD_ID, fin.FINPROD_ABBR AS FINPROD_ABBR, fin.TRADE_MARKET AS TRADE_MARKET, fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AS FINPROD_MARKET_ID, fin.ISSUER AS ISSUER, cust1.IS_FIN_LICENCE AS ISSUER_FIN_LICENCE, fin.FINANCIER AS FINANCIER, cust2.IS_FIN_LICENCE AS FINANCIER_FIN_LICENCE, fin.SPONSOR AS SPONSOR, cust3.IS_FIN_LICENCE AS SPONSOR_FIN_LICENCE, fin.VDATE AS VDATE, fin.MDATE AS MDATE, finAdd.IS_EFF_PLEDGE AS IS_LIMITS, finadd.BOND_RISK_TYPE AS FIRST_RESULT, fin.COUPON_SPECIES AS COUPON_SPECIES, fin.ISSUE_PRICE AS ISSUE_PRICE, fin.ISSUE_AMT AS ISSUE_AMT, typ.TYPE_1 AS SEC_DETAIL_TYPE_MODEL, typ.TYPE_18 AS SEC_TYPE_MODEL,
deal.TRADE_ID AS TRADE_ID, deal.TRADE_DATE AS TRADE_DATE, deal.PS AS PS, ABS(deal.TRADE_AMT) AS TRADE_AMT, ABS(deal.SHARE_AMT) AS SHARE_AMT, deal.YIELD AS YIELD, deal.SETTLE_DATE AS SETTLE_DATE, deal.TRADE_DATE AS TRADE_DATE, deal.MDATE AS PLAN_END_DATE, deal.IS_CLEAN AS IS_CLEAN FROM FIN_PRODUCT fin INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE typ ON fin.FINPROD_ID = typ.FINPROD_ID AND typ.BRANCH = 0 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD finadd ON fin.FINPROD_ID = finadd.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal ON deal.FINPROD_ID = fin.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING ACC ON deal.TRADE_ID = ACC.BUSI_NO INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok ON bok.BOOKSET_ID = ACC.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD prodAdd ON prodAdd.FINPROD_ID = bok.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_VALUTION VAL ON VAL.PORTFOLIO_ID = NVL(prodAdd.PORTFOLIO_ID,bok.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID) AND VAL.FINPROD_ID = deal.FINPROD_ID AND VAL.DSC_COST_AMT != 0 AND VAL.CDATE = #{searchDate} -1 AND VAL.INV_AIM = ACC.INV_AIM LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD cust1 ON fin.ISSUER = cust1.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD cust2 ON fin.FINANCIER = cust2.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD cust3 ON fin.SPONSOR = cust3.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND deal.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND deal.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND typ.TYPE_18 IN (#{SEC_TYPE_01}，#{SEC_TYPE_13}) AND fin.VDATE <= #{searchDate} AND NVL(fin.MDATE, #{searchDate}+1)> #{searchDate} AND (
(deal.PS IN ('T01','T02','T03','T39','T22','T23','T07','T08','T09','T35') AND val. PORTFOLIO_ID IS NOT NULL)
OR (deal.PS IN ('T01','T35') AND val. PORTFOLIO_ID IS NULL AND deal.trade_date = #{searchDate}) ) AND ACC.INV_AIM IN ('AC','FVOCI')
AND (a.FINPROD_ID IN
null) OR a.FINPROD_ID in (
#{item}
)

select OCODE, OTYPE, GRADEORGID, MSTRATINGRESULT01 from ( select OCODE, OTYPE, GRADEORGID, MSTRATINGRESULT01, rank() over (partition by OCODE, OTYPE, GRADEORGID order by GRADEDATE desc) rk from
(SELECT A.OCODE AS OCODE, A.OTYPE AS OTYPE, A.INNEROUTER AS INNEROUTER, A.GRADEORGID AS GRADEORGID, A.GRADEDATE AS GRADEDATE, A.NOTICEDATE AS NOTICEDATE, A.SHORTLONGTERM AS SHORTLONGTERM, A.MSTRATINGRESULT01 AS MSTRATINGRESULT01, A.MSTRATINGRESULT02 AS MSTRATINGRESULT02, A.INPUTTYPE AS INPUTTYPE, A.GRADEEXPECTATION AS GRADEEXPECTATION, A.DIRECTIONCHANGE AS DIRECTIONCHANGE, A.ISSUERRATETYPE AS ISSUERRATETYPE FROM ( SELECT MBCR.O_CODE AS OCODE, MBCR.O_TYPE AS OTYPE, '01' AS INNEROUTER, MBCR.GRADE_ORG_ID AS GRADEORGID, MBCR.GRADE_DATE AS GRADEDATE, MBCR.NOTICE_DATE AS NOTICEDATE, MBCR.SHORT_LONG_TERM AS SHORTLONGTERM, MBCR.GRADE_RESULT AS MSTRATINGRESULT01, MRM.GRADE_RESULT_ST AS MSTRATINGRESULT02, MBCR.INPUT_TYPE AS INPUTTYPE, MBCR.GRADE_EXPECTATION AS GRADEEXPECTATION, MBCR.DIRECTION_CHANGE AS DIRECTIONCHANGE, MBCR.ISSUER_RATE_TYPE AS ISSUERRATETYPE FROM MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING MBCR LEFT JOIN MST_RATING_MATCH MRM ON MBCR.GRADE_RESULT = MRM.GRADE_RESULT_OR UNION ALL SELECT MICR.O_CODE AS OCODE, MICR.O_TYPE AS OTYPE, '02' AS INNEROUTER, MICR.GRADE_ORG_ID AS GRADEORGID, MICR.GRADE_DATE AS GRADEDATE, NULL AS NOTICEDATE, NULL AS SHORTLONGTERM, MICR.GRADE_RESULT AS MSTRATINGRESULT01, MRM1.GRADE_RESULT_ST AS MSTRATINGRESULT02, MICR.INPUT_TYPE AS INPUTTYPE, NULL AS GRADEEXPECTATION, NULL AS DIRECTIONCHANGE, NULL AS ISSUERRATETYPE FROM MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING MICR LEFT JOIN MST_RATING_MATCH MRM1 ON MICR.GRADE_RESULT = MRM1.GRADE_RESULT_OR) A) where GRADEDATE <= #{searchDate, jdbcType=DATE}) where rk = 1

select OCODE, OTYPE, GRADEORGID, MSTRATINGRESULT01 #{searchDate, jdbcType=DATE} searchDate from ( select OCODE, OTYPE, GRADEORGID, MSTRATINGRESULT01, rank() over (partition by OCODE, OTYPE, GRADEORGID order by GRADEDATE desc) rk from
(SELECT A.OCODE AS OCODE, A.OTYPE AS OTYPE, A.INNEROUTER AS INNEROUTER, A.GRADEORGID AS GRADEORGID, A.GRADEDATE AS GRADEDATE, A.NOTICEDATE AS NOTICEDATE, A.SHORTLONGTERM AS SHORTLONGTERM, A.MSTRATINGRESULT01 AS MSTRATINGRESULT01, A.INPUTTYPE AS INPUTTYPE, A.GRADEEXPECTATION AS GRADEEXPECTATION, A.DIRECTIONCHANGE AS DIRECTIONCHANGE, A.ISSUERRATETYPE AS ISSUERRATETYPE FROM ( SELECT MBCR.O_CODE AS OCODE, MBCR.O_TYPE AS OTYPE, '01' AS INNEROUTER, MBCR.GRADE_ORG_ID AS GRADEORGID, MBCR.GRADE_DATE AS GRADEDATE, MBCR.NOTICE_DATE AS NOTICEDATE, MBCR.SHORT_LONG_TERM AS SHORTLONGTERM, MBCR.GRADE_RESULT AS MSTRATINGRESULT01, MBCR.INPUT_TYPE AS INPUTTYPE, MBCR.GRADE_EXPECTATION AS GRADEEXPECTATION, MBCR.DIRECTION_CHANGE AS DIRECTIONCHANGE, MBCR.ISSUER_RATE_TYPE AS ISSUERRATETYPE FROM MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING MBCR UNION ALL SELECT MICR.O_CODE AS OCODE, MICR.O_TYPE AS OTYPE, '02' AS INNEROUTER, MICR.GRADE_ORG_ID AS GRADEORGID, MICR.GRADE_DATE AS GRADEDATE, NULL AS NOTICEDATE, NULL AS SHORTLONGTERM, MICR.GRADE_RESULT AS MSTRATINGRESULT01, MICR.INPUT_TYPE AS INPUTTYPE, NULL AS GRADEEXPECTATION, NULL AS DIRECTIONCHANGE, NULL AS ISSUERRATETYPE FROM MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING MICR) A) where 1=1
AND (
(OCODE = #{item.ocode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and OTYPE = #{item.otype,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and GRADEORGID = #{item.gradeorgid,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
)
and GRADEDATE <= #{searchDate, jdbcType=DATE}) where rk = 1
